children: About 73,000 Pacific Gas and Electric customers were recently without power, or about 1.3% of its customers, as the utility implemented public safety power shutoffs to reduce wildfire risk.
The company's outage map recently indicated that Alpine County was entirely without service, while Sierra County had a 99.7% outage percentage.

Meanwhile, Southern California Edison's website indicated very few current outages but that shutoffs are being considered for about 254,000 customers, or 5% of its total, including more than 126,000 in Ventura County and 90,000 in Los Angeles County. A map showed many areas that are likely to have a shutoff in the next one to four hours.
PG&E said Tuesday it was monitoring a potential dry offshore wind event forecast for Wednesday evening through Saturday evening.
